List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile

Source: R/fingertips.R
fingertips_amr_indicators.Rd

Returns the catalogue of indicators in the UKHSA Fingertips "AMR local indicators" profile (profile 101), one row per indicator, with the full UKHSA metadata and the classification from classify_fingertips_indicators. No indicator data are downloaded, so this is the quick way to see what download_fingertips_amr would fetch.

Usage

fingertips_amr_indicators(
  themes = "all",
  rolling = c("include", "exclude", "only"),
  profile_id = .fingertips_profile_id
)

Arguments

themes

character vector of themes to keep: any of "prescribing", "resistance", "testing", "cases", "stewardship", "ipc", "other", or "all" (the default).

rolling

"include" (default) keeps every indicator, "exclude" drops rolling series, "only" keeps only rolling series.

profile_id

Fingertips profile ID. The default, 101, is "AMR local indicators - produced by the UKHSA".

Value

A data.frame with one row per indicator.

Details

Requires the fingertipsR package, which is not currently on CRAN: pak::pak("ropensci/fingertipsR").

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("fingertipsR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat_tbl <- fingertips_amr_indicators(themes = "resistance", rolling = "exclude")
  head(cat_tbl[, c("IndicatorID", "IndicatorName", "period_type")])
}
#>   IndicatorID
#> 1       92519
#> 2       92521
#>                                                                                                  IndicatorName
#> 1   Percentage of community E. coli urine specimens resistant to trimethoprim; by ICB sub-location and quarter
#> 2 Percentage of community E. coli urine specimens resistant to nitrofurantoin; by ICB sub-location and quarter
#>   period_type
#> 1     quarter
#> 2     quarter
# }
